description: Lays out a story, memoir, letters or recipe collection from this conversation as a printed 8.5-inch square book and shows a page-by-page preview. Use it when the user wants something written in the chat turned into a physical book, or to change a book made earlier (pass book_id; only the fields you pass change). Pass the text exactly as written, split into sections (one per page of a picture book, or one per chapter/recipe). Never summarise or shorten it. This client cannot pass pictures from the conversation: leave `images` empty; the result has an editor link where the user uploads pictures. This only creates a draft preview; nothing is printed or charged.

author.description: Author name as it should appear on the cover, e.g. "Grandma Rosa"

book_id.description: Id of a book made earlier, to update it

country.description: ISO country code the book will ship to, if known, to show the right price

cover_image.description: Index into `images` for the front cover; defaults to the first picture

dedication.description: Dedication page text, e.g. "For Lucía, love Mum"

full_text.description: Alternative to sections: the whole text; it is split at blank lines

images.description: Pictures from the conversation, in the order referenced by sections

download_url.description: Temporary download URL of the file

language.description: Language the book is written in (sets the printed words like "The End"). Defaults to the conversation language.

heading.description: Chapter or recipe title, if the text has one

image.description: Index into `images` of the picture that goes with this part

image_url.description: Public https URL of a picture for this part, when the picture is not a conversation file

text.description: The text for this part, exactly as written in the conversation

style.description: picture = one picture and short text per spread (children's stories); text = flowing chapters (memoirs, recipes, letters)

name: layout_book
title: Lay out a printed book
